properties.name: Faustini Rim A
properties.primary_target: PSR volatile trap along Faustini crater rim
properties.description: High-altitude rim crest bordering permanently shadowed region (PSR). Offers favorable direct-to-Earth communications and extended solar illumination periods.

properties.name: Peak Near Shackleton
properties.description: Topographic peak 0.46 degrees from the true Lunar South Pole. Prime location for polar solar arrays with access to the floor of Shackleton crater.

properties.name: Connecting Ridge
properties.primary_target: High ground connecting Shackleton to de Gerlache
properties.description: Narrow elevated ridge linking Shackleton crater to the de Gerlache rim. Exceptionally low local slopes suitable for commercial landing pads.

properties.name: Connecting Ridge Extension
properties.description: Northwest continuation of the Connecting Ridge feature. Broad terrain facilitating multi-lander surface infrastructure deployment.

properties.name: de Gerlache Rim 1
properties.primary_target: Stratified impact melt and regolith breccia
properties.description: Prominent eastern crest of de Gerlache crater. Direct line-of-sight to Earth combined with proximity to deep hydrogen deposits inside the crater floor.

properties.name: de Gerlache Rim 2
properties.description: Secondary shoulder along de Gerlache rim. Moderate slopes requiring real-time hazard avoidance during final powered descent phase.

properties.name: de Gerlache-Kocher Massif
properties.description: Massive elevated plateau standing over 1.4 km above adjacent floor. Offers long-duration solar exposure but steeper localized flank slopes.

properties.name: Haworth
properties.primary_target: Deep cold trap rim with surface frost signatures
properties.description: Smooth saddle region perched above Haworth crater interior, identified by LRO LAMP and Mini-RF as harboring surficial water-ice signatures.

properties.name: Malapert Mountain
properties.primary_target: Peak of Eternal Light candidate / Telecoms Relay
properties.description: Historic landing site candidate for Intuitive Machines IM-1. Malapert Mountain stands over 5 km high with flat crest summits receiving over 90% annual illumination.

properties.name: Leibnitz Beta Plateau
properties.primary_target: South Pole-Aitken Basin deep excavation strata
properties.description: Extensive elevated plateau on the South Pole-Aitken basin margin. Flat, smooth landing areas with clear line of sight to Earth stations.

properties.name: Nobile Rim 1
properties.primary_target: Volatile-bearing terrain within rover driving range
properties.description: Selected landing region for the Astrobotic Griffin lander and NASA VIPER rover mission. Characterized by wide, gently undulating terrain with shallow impact craters.

properties.name: Nobile Rim 2
properties.description: Western terrace flanking Nobile crater. Good mobility access corridor across multiple permanently shadowed cold traps.

properties.name: Amundsen Rim
properties.primary_target: Anorthositic central peak and rim terrace
properties.description: Northernmost candidate region offering direct communications with Earth ground antennas and smooth terrace steps for safe touchdown.
